data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Ar-Rafa’a’ meaning ‘to raise up’, Arveen is a name of immense grace and beauty. This name is perfect for parents who seek a name that reflects their child’s exquisite qualities. The name Arveen carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arveen usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arveen is a name that represents the spiritual journey of growth and self-improvement. It encourages the bearer to strive for excellence in all aspects of life, and to uplift and inspire others.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arveen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
data.cultural_impact: The name Arveen carries a sense of promising growth and upliftment, stemming from its roots in Islamic culture. It is a name resonating with the values of hope and resilience, inspiring its bearer to strive for success and reach new heights.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Arveen signifies the journey towards self-improvement and personal growth. This name is a reminder that each of us has the innate ability to rise above our challenges and overcome adversity. In Islam, the concept of ‘Ar-Rafa’a’ is synonymous with the idea of being lifted up spiritually, drawing closer to Allah (SWT) in the process. Thus, the name Arveen serves as a constant reminder of the divine power within us all and the potential for spiritual growth that awaits each individual on their unique journey towards self-discovery and enlightenment.
